propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the implementation plan, action log and consultant schedule for six enterprise implementations and kept the customer status page current.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the action log document the planning work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate hosted the weekly customer status call for her implementations and recorded decisions and actions.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the status-call work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the implementations end-to-end, held the customer go-live sign-off and managed consultant assignments.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns consultant assignments to the delivery manager and go-live sign-off to the sponsor and the delivery manager; the candidate's own screen remark confirms who signed.

expectedGap: The materials show plan maintenance, status calls and escalation by the candidate; they do not show her holding go-live sign-off or deciding consultant assignments.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: assignments by the delivery manager, go-live signed by the sponsor and the delivery manager; the candidate coordinated.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ever signed a go-live herself or assigned consultants, and on which implementations.
